WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity,
    (AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) OVER ()) AS overall_average_quantity,
    (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
  invoice_number,
  average_quantity,
  relative_gap,
  average_quantity - overall_average_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average
FROM invoice_averages
WHERE average_quantity > overall_average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
